company.description: Aviron Interactive is a fitness company offering a rower with gamification features. It is a connected rowing machine designed with the user in mind. Short, high-intensity workouts save time, high resistance settings allow to include strength training along with cardio workout, and hundreds of content options to get motivated and keep engaged month after month.

aiResearchSummary.text: Aviron Interactive is researching and developing an adjustable foot plate for rowing machines, as described in the title 'Adjustable foot plate for rowing machines.' The abstract details a foot plate with two platforms, each featuring a strap, heel counter, and a lengthening member to adjust the distance between the strap and heel counter, enhancing user customization during rowing. This area of research and development focuses on improving the ergonomics and adaptability of rowing machine components.
